newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel supported by refiner interes.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel supported by refiner interes.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices held steady on Monday as crude futures reversed early gains. Traders said the market was getting good support on perceptions of refinery crude run-cuts.
They said there were good supplies of straight run material, but while crude refining margins remain poor they expected demand for straight-run barrels as a feed stock to remain healthy.
M-100 cargoes valued steady around $98 cif ARA after trade at the level on Friday. Russian E4 was seen bid at around three means +$2 a tonne while North Sea barrels valued $113 cif.
